summary: Frontend-only rebrand verification completed on public preview URL. Pixel TIPRR logo replacement, image-only branding, favicon swap, pixel typography theme, route responsiveness, and key signed-out interactions were tested end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Repeated /api/me 401 errors appear in browser console during unsigned sessions (UI still usable; likely expected auth probe but noisy).

action_items: Optional: reduce console noise by handling expected signed-out /api/me 401 responses without repeated error-level logs.
Optional cleanup: remove legacy mascot-related CSS blocks in App.css that are no longer used by current BrandImage implementation.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy mascot-oriented CSS remains in /app/frontend/src/App.css (e.g., .hero-mascot/.pixel-bot classes). Not currently breaking UI, but should be cleaned to prevent style drift and confusion in future edits.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://bonk-sender.preview.emergentagent.com with desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 + 320x800. All requested routes load without horizontal overflow. Header/sidebar/mobile brand links are image-only (no duplicate TIPRR text). Favicon points to /tiprr-logo-icon.png and returns 200. Bot demo tabs (SOL/BONK/USDC) and pause/replay work after waiting for reply animation.
rca of the issue: Observed console 401s are tied to unauthenticated /api/me probes while signed-out, not to rebrand asset changes. Repro: open home/dashboard as guest and inspect browser console logs. Mitigation: downgrade expected 401 handling to non-error telemetry/log level in frontend API layer.
